name: CLI-Anything Hub
summary: Agent-friendly CLI registry and package manager that lets AI agents discover, install and drive tools.
description: An agent-friendly registry and package manager for command-line tools. cli-hub (pip install cli-anything-hub) lists, searches, inspects, installs and launches agent-native CLIs that drive GUI applications, developer tools, creative software, web APIs and public SaaS platforms, and bundles tools into capability-based Workflow Matrices. Every command has --json output and a documented exit-code contract; generated harness CLIs ship with REPL mode and local project state.
contains: Registry of agent-native CLI harnesses and public CLI tools
cli-hub commands: list, search, info, install, update, uninstall, launch
Workflow Matrices bundle capabilities across CLI, library and cloud API providers
--json output and a documented exit-code contract
Generated harness CLIs with REPL mode, one-shot commands and local project state
Meta-skill installable with npx skills; needs Python 3.10+
Free and open source under Apache-2.0
